''See also: [[Petal Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Petal is a reserved and anxious individual characterized by her frizzy black hair, which she often uses to hide her face or expressions. She frequently displays signs of nervousness, such as trembling, shivering, or shrinking into herself, and she finds social interaction and confrontation difficult. Despite her timid nature, she has demonstrated a protective, sisterly instinct toward [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]] and has expressed opinions regarding political matters, specifically concerning the Heart and the potential for an Emperor. Her skills or tasks include collecting glowing liquid from a Stormwing spine, handling potions, and using acid. She is often seen carrying items like a bag, a [[quicklamp]], or bottled substances for her work.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Petal is the sister of [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]]. She serves as a crew member under [[Calder]] and works alongside [[Dalton Foster|Foster]], [[Andel Petronus|Andel]], and [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]]. Additionally, she has interacted with [[Kelarac]] by throwing a glass bottle at them.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Crew of Calder}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|As a member of the crew, Petal serves as the ship's resident alchemist, a role she attained through self-training.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref> During one instance, she sought cover behind a barrel.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" /> She later provided a potion that caused [[Calder]] to smile.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 7</ref> Petal accompanied [[Andel Petronus|Andel]] and [[Dalton Foster|Foster]] on a visit to the main base of the [[Blackwatch]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref> While pouring powder into a weapon, her hands were shaking.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11" /> She carries a case of potions and has been seen with a bottled potion in hand.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c18">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 18</ref> At times, she shivers and hides her face within her hair.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c17">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Life on The Testament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|By the standards of [[Kanatalia]], Petal is a journeyman alchemist who resides on the ship known as [[The Testament]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 3</ref> She is the sister of [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]] and carries a pouch at her waist while harboring a deep craving for alchemical knowledge.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3" /> After tearing up to match [[Calder]], she utilized an acid solution.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref> As a crew member working alongside [[Dalton Foster|Foster]] on [[The Testament]], she was seen tending to [[Andel Petronus|Andel]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref> Petal eventually presented an experimental draught to [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Stay with the Champions}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Petal is a woman working with the [[Champions]] who currently resides in a building rented by the [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref> Believing that [[Calder]] is not dead, she has attempted to share her research notes with others since his arrival.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" /> After researching how to borrow the power of a [[Champion]], she checked [[Calder]]'s eyes and reacted emotionally to his state.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref> She provided [[Calder]] with medical supplies and whispered to ask about his condition.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref> While on the ramp of [[The Testament]], Petal enhanced [[Calder]]'s body and devised a cocktail for [[Redshot]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref> She sent a wax-paper packet to [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] and offered [[Andel Petronus|Andel]] an encouraging smile.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref> Appearing ready to bolt and shivering, she used an alchemical sprayer before throwing a glass bottle of thick pink liquid at [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref> Petal hugged [[Calder]] and eventually joined the crowd surrounding [[Dalton Foster|Foster]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c26">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">18</span></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Petal popped her head up. “I still like it here,” she said.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“That’s right. And we are, Petal. We are. So can you trust your sister, this once, when I tell you that what I’m doing isn’t going to hurt anyone?<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“What’s wrong with him?” Petal whispered.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}
